description: SESSION ON STUDY SKILLS, MEMORY TECHNIQUES AND GOAL SETTLING BY RTN. DR DAREKAR AT CHHATRAPATI SHIVAJI VIDYALAYA. The session was designed to help students develop effective study habits, understand the importance of goal setting, and gain greater clarity about their personal aspirations and purpose. The session focused on helping students understand that academic success is not merely about studying harder, but about studying smarter, developing the right habits, and working consistently towards clearly defined goals. During the session, students were introduced to practical study techniques to improve focus and concentration, develop effective study habits, and make better use of planning and time management. The importance of consistency and discipline was also emphasized, with students encouraged to understand that regular and purposeful effort plays a vital role in achieving long-term success. They were guided on how to convert their aspirations into specific and achievable goals.
